reviews.title: Terrible, recent update. (Summer 2026)
reviews.text:
A recent update has introduced frequent automatic logouts, and this is a terrible design decision for an app like this.

I use the app to log my vehicles’ odometer readings roughly every 4–6 weeks so I can keep track of maintenance intervals. Now, nearly every time I open the app to update the mileage, I’ve been logged out and have to go through the email verification-code process again. That added friction is already making me less likely to bother entering the information.

More importantly, being automatically logged out can prevent maintenance and recall notifications from being delivered. That undermines one of the app’s most useful purposes.

This is not a banking or other high-security app containing particularly sensitive information. There is no reasonable need for login sessions to expire this aggressively, especially when doing so interferes with notifications and normal use.

Please restore long-term login retention. This has been one of the best places to keep vehicle maintenance information—but only if the app actually stays logged in.

Edit to your reply - I did contact CarFax (twice) about this degradation of the iOS app's usefulness and received pointless boilerplate "the app was updated for security" replies, indicating this botched 1-week login period was intentional. Personally, I'd like to get maintenance reminders and they won't work if the app is always logged out. It's not an issue you can fix for "me", it's an issue you need to fix in your app design.

reviews.title: Better than Nothing, But Not Very Functional
reviews.text:
This app does track your service history, but in an extremely primitive and clunky way. 

For example, you can’t pull up a record of your oil changes, a record of the last time you changed transmission fluid, etc.

You have to scroll down through every single service visit you’ve had a read the list of things done.

Also, it tells you what is needed, but only if you use the regular maintenance schedule. If you use the severe schedule, you’re SOL.

Pretty embarrassing to have such limited functionality in 2026.

So now I’ve lost almost all of my maintenance information and have to try to dig back through records from two or three different shops to figure out what I’ve had done. Looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Cleared out all of my Vehicle history
reviews.text: This app was working very well for a while. I really appreciated being able to more accurately track my gas mileage, get reminders and recommended services that are more conservative than the manual, and adding maintaining accurate records without all the clutter. However, I recently had to login again to the app and it did not have my vehicle saved. I thought, “Okay, when I add it back it will pull all of my fill-up records.” NO. It cleared ALL of them, and even claimed that I’d driven 15,000 miles in one year on my 1.5 year old tires…completely incorrect. I’ve maintained my vehicle extremely well and it’s frustrating that the app I’ve trusted to keep my records failed to even do that. Do better devs, keep backups or something. Being logged out occasionally for security purposes should NOT clear all records kept.
